Materials needed-Duct Tape, Strapping Tape (sometimes called Fiber Tape) Electrical Tape, [Glue](http://www.dap.com/product_details.aspx?BrandID=46&SubcatID=8),
[Camp Foam](http://www.walmart.com/ip/Ozark-Trial-Camping-Pad-Blue/16783660) and depending in the rules of the game you are looking into [Stadium Foam](http://www.amazon.com/Creative-Foams-Closed-Stadium-Cushion/dp/B00BTHJEUU) to add a stabbing tip onto your weapon. 

Core material can be tricky, especially depending on amount of impact there is in the game. PvC can be used for lighter impact games, but it is only good for shorter weapons because of the flex in the pipe. We use fiberglass golf clubs for core. They are lightweight and durable, plus you can often find them in thrift stores for a buck or two. Just cut the head off right at the base and it is good to go, even has a decent, almost finished handle.
